The wrecks brought you here. The details help you plan.

Learn about Coron's underwater destinations, then talk with W Divers about a plan that fits your experience. Site selection depends on conditions, your training and the arrangements available for your dates.

Discover Coron's Dive Sites Wreck Diving Reef Diving

A few names you may already know.

Short introductions to some of Coron's best-known wrecks. Each guide explains what to ask before you plan a visit.

  • Wreck Okikawa Maru A large wreck with coral growth and abundant marine life around its structure.
  • Wreck Akitsushima A seaplane tender known for its distinctive crane and machinery.
  • Wreck Olympia Maru A cargo wreck with an imposing underwater presence.
  • Wreck Kogyo Maru A cargo wreck associated with wartime construction supplies.
